rationale: Price is sitting at 5.2% of today's range, essentially pinned at the session low ($31.06) with the last five 1-minute candles showing extremely tight, low-momentum oscillation between $31.06 and $31.12 — no directional conviction in either direction. The gap down of -1.73% has already been absorbed and the stock is compressing near the low without a clear breakout or rejection signal; entering long risks catching a falling knife while entering short at the very low of the range offers poor risk/reward with minimal room before the stop would need to be placed above a structurally ambiguous level. With today already showing a realized loss, the evidence does not justify committing capital here.
